EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY: This Go-To-Market plan defines the commercialization strategy for the PROD_FRESH_GAN65_BENCHMARK 65W GaN USB-C charger in Vietnam's ecommerce market. Leveraging GaN semiconductor architecture to deliver a compact portable form factor capable of up to 65W output, the launch targets Vietnamese tech commuters and office professionals seeking portable charging for compatible USB-C devices. Because critical parameters—such as exact port configuration, safety certifications, thermal metrics, pricing, and unit economics—remain UNKNOWN / TO_BE_ESTABLISHED, the plan operates under a SUPERVISED protocol requiring explicit human approval prior to public release, paired with strict claim discipline.
RESEARCH_FINDINGS: EVID-GAN65-01: GaN semiconductors enable higher power efficiency, higher switching frequencies, and smaller form factors compared to legacy silicon MOSFETs (Source: TI Technical Documentation).
EVID-GAN65-02: 65W USB-C Power Delivery can charge typical 13-inch and 14-inch ultrabooks and fast-charging smartphones through universal Type-C negotiation (Source: USB-IF Technical Documentation).

EVID-GAN65-03: Vietnamese office workers and commuters report fatigue carrying heavy OEM brick chargers and express concerns regarding thermal heat and wall socket stability (Source: Tinhte.vn discussion).

EVID-GAN65-04: Ecommerce landscape on Shopee Vietnam shows 65W GaN chargers priced between 300,000 VND and 700,000 VND, with demand centered on compact size, fast handshake, and port versatility (Source: Shopee VN search discovery).

EVID-GAN65-05: Vietnamese tech forum communities (Voz.vn) express strong concern regarding uncertified knockoffs causing voltage surges/hardware damage and demand verified safety and warranty support.

The 65W GaN market in Vietnam features established third-party brands including Baseus, Ugreen, and Anker on Shopee.
INFERENCES: Consumers who carry OEM power bricks daily are likely receptive to a compact 65W GaN alternative for compatible USB-C devices.
Clear communication addressing reliability and device safety may mitigate consumer hesitation regarding third-party power adapters on Vietnamese marketplaces.
HYPOTHESES: Positioning the product around compact mobility for compatible USB-C devices will generate higher CTR on Vietnamese ecommerce platforms compared to generic GaN spec messaging.
Displaying transparent technical specifications and warranty terms will reduce customer drop-off driven by knockoff/surge concerns.
